messages:
maria: Heads-up — multiple otel_gateway_backpressure alerts in eu-west-1 at ~01:20 UTC. GPUs autoscaled down during the midnight window and the collector queue filled. Spans are being dropped.
kevin: logs?
maria: kubectl logs otel-gateway-7f8b -n observability | tail -n 50
```
2026-03-10T01:22:48Z WARN exporter/otlp: failed to send 93 spans: queue full
2026-03-10T01:22:49Z ERROR receiver: drop span: buffer limit reached
2026-03-10T01:23:00Z INFO service: received shutdown signal
```
li: That pattern usually means batcher/max_queue_size reached + downstream exporter backpressure. What's the gateway's batching config? Also are connectors using SDK batch settings that match the gateway?
ana: Grafana panels spiking: otel_collector_queue_length -> 1200, trace_ingest_rate down 30%. Alerts: `Alertname='otel_gateway_backpressure'` and `SLO:inference_p99_latency` jumping
sre-oncall: We should avoid scale-to-zero in that time window for gpu pools. Quick mitigation: enable persistent queueing on collector and bump queued_retry. File-based queue prevents data loss during short backpressure.
kevin: Agreed. Short term: set nodepool min=4 for eu-gpu-pool between 00:00-06:00 UTC. Also add pod disruption budget to prevent mass evictions during maintenance.
maria: Proposed patch to otel-collector config (canary):
```
queue:
  memory: 100000
  file_storage:
    enabled: true
    path: /var/lib/otelcol/queue.db
batch:
  timeout: 5s
  max_export_batch_size: 512
retry:
  enabled: true
  initial_interval: 100ms
```
kevin: Also set SDKs to use `batch` exporter with `max_queue_size=2048` and `scheduled_delay_millis=200` where possible. Some Rust SDK clients default too small.
jen: Note baggage propagation issue: some runtime spans arrive without tracebaggage headers — check that gateway preserves `baggage` and `traceparent` during transform. Current nginx sidecar config strips unknown headers on 400s.
li: Quick gateway change: set `preserve_on_retry: true`, `queued_retry: { enabled: true }` and add header whitelist `traceparent,baggage,x-request-id`. Test locally with `otelcol --config ./config.yml --dry-run`.
ops-bot: Rollout started: deployment/otel-gateway v3 -> v4 (canary 10%) :point_right: https://deploys.redwood.example/r/otel-gateway/1234
maria: I'll open PR with the file-queue + header whitelist + docs for GPU scale-window. Can we get someone to watch the p99 panel for 30m after canary?
kevin: I can watch; ping me @kevin when canary hits 50%.
ana: I'll mute non-actionable alerts during the change window and annotate runbook.
sre-oncall: If persistent queue doesn't help, fallback plan is to route traces to a temporary S3-backed uploader and reduce batch size on exporters to lower memory.
maria: thanks all. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/567 — will tag reviewers.
kevin: :thumbsup:
li: :rocket:
